question: In which year did Guru Indira PP Bora receive the Padma Shri Award?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru Indira PP Bora** is an acclaimed **Sattriya dancer**, choreographer, and teacher from Assam.
 
• She was honored with the prestigious **Padma Shri Award** in the year **2020** for her contributions to the field of dance.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• Guru Indira PP Bora is a pioneer in **Sattriya dance**, an Indian classical dance form originating from Assam.
 
• She has dedicated her life to the promotion and preservation of **Sattriya culture**, which is deeply rooted in the teachings of **Maha Purush Srimanta Sankardeva**, a saint-scholar from Assam.
 
• Her efforts have helped **Sattriya dance** gain national and international recognition as one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• She is known for blending traditional elements of **Sattriya dance** with modern choreography, making it accessible to a wider audience.
 
• Guru Indira PP Bora has trained numerous students and performed extensively across India and abroad, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of Assam.
